Isaiah 1:18.prayer: God, you invite me to come and reason with you. Wash me white as snow.

Psalm 34:5.reflect: What would it feel like to lift your face without shame?
Psalm 34:5.prayer: God, as I look to you, let my face shine and never be covered with shame.

2 Corinthians 5:17.reflect: What old thing is passing away, and what new thing is beginning?
2 Corinthians 5:17.prayer: God, make me new in you. Help me live from that newness today.

Isaiah 54:4.reflect: What shame from the past would you like God to lift?
Isaiah 54:4.prayer: God, take away my fear and shame. Help me not to be ashamed anymore.

Micah 7:18-19.reflect: What would it mean for your wrongs to be cast into the sea?
Micah 7:18-19.prayer: God, you delight in mercy. Throw my sins into the depths of the sea.

Isaiah 43:25.reflect: How does it feel to be forgiven and not remembered for your wrongs?
Isaiah 43:25.prayer: God, you blot out my sins and remember them no more. Help me receive that mercy.

Acts 3:19.reflect: What turning back toward God feels possible today?
Acts 3:19.prayer: God, I turn back to you. Wipe away my sins and refresh me with your presence.

Luke 15:20.reflect: What would it mean to be welcomed home while still far off?
Luke 15:20.prayer: Father, I am coming home. Thank you for running to meet me.

Psalm 37:23-24.reflect: Where have you stumbled but not fallen all the way?
Psalm 37:23-24.prayer: God, when I stumble, hold me by the hand. Do not let me fall headlong.

Micah 7:8.reflect: Where could you get up again today?
Micah 7:8.prayer: God, I have fallen, but I will rise. Be my light in this darkness.

Proverbs 24:16.reflect: What would rising again look like after this mistake?
Proverbs 24:16.prayer: God, I fell again. Help me get back up with you.

Psalm 145:14.reflect: Where do you need to be lifted up right now?
Psalm 145:14.prayer: God, you uphold all who fall. Raise me up again.

Romans 7:24-25.reflect: What struggle do you want to bring honestly to Jesus?
Romans 7:24-25.prayer: Jesus, I cannot do this on my own. Thank you that you rescue me.

James 4:7.reflect: What would it look like to submit to God and resist in this moment?
James 4:7.prayer: God, I submit myself to you. Give me strength to resist what pulls me away.

Psalm 119:11.reflect: What word could you hold close for the next time you are tempted?
Psalm 119:11.prayer: God, help me treasure your word in my heart so I do not turn from you.

1 John 2:1.reflect: How does it feel to know you have an advocate with the Father?
1 John 2:1.prayer: Jesus, when I fall short, you speak for me. Help me rest in your grace.

Psalm 16:6.reflect: Where have the lines of your life fallen in pleasant places?
Psalm 16:6.prayer: God, thank you for the good places you have given me. Open my eyes to them.

Numbers 6:24-26.reflect: Who could you pray this blessing over today?
Numbers 6:24-26.prayer: God, bless me and keep me. Make your face shine on me and give me peace.

Ephesians 1:3.reflect: Which spiritual blessing are you most grateful for today?
Ephesians 1:3.prayer: God, thank you for every blessing in Christ. Help me live as one who is richly blessed.

Psalm 23:5-6.reflect: Where has goodness and mercy followed you?
Psalm 23:5-6.prayer: God, my cup overflows. Thank you that your goodness and mercy follow me.

Philippians 4:4.reflect: What reason to rejoice do you want to name out loud?
Philippians 4:4.prayer: God, I rejoice in you today. Let my joy be gentle and real.

Psalm 126:3.reflect: What great thing would you like to thank God for?
Psalm 126:3.prayer: God, you have done great things for me, and I am glad.

Psalm 30:11-12.reflect: What sorrow has turned to dancing in your life?
Psalm 30:11-12.prayer: God, you turned my mourning into dancing. I will thank you forever.

Ecclesiastes 3:4.reflect: How could you make room to fully enjoy this season of laughter?
Ecclesiastes 3:4.prayer: God, thank you for this time to laugh and dance. Help me receive it fully.

Proverbs 27:17.prayer: God, thank you for people who make me better. Help me do the same for them.

Ecclesiastes 4:9-10.reflect: Who has helped you up when you fell?
Ecclesiastes 4:9-10.prayer: God, thank you for the people who lift me up. Help me be that friend too.

Proverbs 17:17.reflect: Which friend has loved you at all times?
Proverbs 17:17.prayer: God, thank you for faithful friends. Bless them today.

Colossians 1:3-4.reflect: Whose faith and love are you thankful for?
Colossians 1:3-4.prayer: God, I thank you for the people whose faith and love encourage me.

Psalm 28:6-7.reflect: What prayer has God answered that you want to remember?
Psalm 28:6-7.prayer: God, you heard my cry. My heart trusts you, and I will give you thanks.

Psalm 34:4.reflect: What fear has God delivered you from?
Psalm 34:4.prayer: God, I sought you and you answered me. Thank you for freeing me from my fears.

1 John 5:14-15.reflect: What does it mean to you that God hears your prayers?
1 John 5:14-15.prayer: God, thank you for hearing me. Help me keep praying with confidence.

Psalm 118:21.reflect: How would you like to thank God for this answer?
Psalm 118:21.prayer: God, I thank you, for you have answered me and become my salvation.

Isaiah 43:18-19.reflect: What new thing might be springing up in your life?
Isaiah 43:18-19.prayer: God, help me let go of what was. Open my eyes to the new thing you are doing.

Psalm 90:17.reflect: What work of your hands would you like God to establish?
Psalm 90:17.prayer: God, let your favor rest on me. Establish the work of my hands.

Proverbs 16:3.reflect: What plan could you commit to God today?
Proverbs 16:3.prayer: God, I commit my plans to you. Establish them in your way.

Ecclesiastes 3:1.reflect: What season are you entering, and what does it ask of you?
Ecclesiastes 3:1.prayer: God, there is a time for everything. Help me step into this new season well.

Psalm 130:5-6.reflect: What are you watching and waiting for, like the morning?
Psalm 130:5-6.prayer: God, my soul waits for you more than watchmen wait for the morning.

Habakkuk 2:3.reflect: What promise feels slow, and how could you hold it with patience?
Habakkuk 2:3.prayer: God, though it seems slow, help me wait for what you will surely bring.

Micah 7:7.reflect: What would it look like to keep watching for God today?
Micah 7:7.prayer: God, I will look to you and wait. Hear me as I pray.

Psalm 62:5.reflect: Where does your hope come from right now?
Psalm 62:5.prayer: God, my soul waits in silence for you. My hope comes from you.

Proverbs 16:9.reflect: How could you plan and still leave room for God to lead?
Proverbs 16:9.prayer: God, I make my plans. Guide my steps as I choose.

Isaiah 30:21.reflect: Which way feels quietly right when you listen closely?
Isaiah 30:21.prayer: God, help me hear your voice guiding me toward the way to walk.

Psalm 32:8.reflect: Where do you need counsel and a watchful eye?
Psalm 32:8.prayer: God, instruct me and teach me the way to go. Counsel me with your eye on me.

Proverbs 19:21.reflect: Which of your plans could you hold with an open hand?
Proverbs 19:21.prayer: God, many plans are in my heart. Let your purpose stand.

Psalm 143:8.reflect: What would it look like to hear God's love in the morning?
Psalm 143:8.prayer: God, let me hear of your loving kindness in the morning. Show me the way to walk.

Isaiah 42:16.reflect: Where do you feel like you are walking in the dark?
Isaiah 42:16.prayer: God, lead me by paths I do not know. Turn the darkness into light before me.

John 8:12.reflect: Where do you need light for your next step?
John 8:12.prayer: Jesus, you are the light of the world. Help me follow you and not walk in darkness.

Proverbs 4:11.reflect: Where have you been led along a straight path before?
Proverbs 4:11.prayer: God, teach me the way of wisdom and lead me in straight paths.

Hebrews 11:1.reflect: What are you hoping for that you cannot yet see?
Hebrews 11:1.prayer: God, give me faith for what I hope for and cannot see yet.

Psalm 73:23-24.reflect: Even with your questions, where have you sensed God holding on to you?
Psalm 73:23-24.prayer: God, even when I doubt, you hold my right hand. Guide me with your counsel.

Romans 10:17.reflect: What word from God would you like to hear again today?
Romans 10:17.prayer: God, let my faith grow as I listen to your word.

John 6:68-69.reflect: Even with questions, where else would you go?
John 6:68-69.prayer: Jesus, you have the words of life. Even with my questions, I want to stay with you.

Acts 17:27.reflect: Where might God be closer than you feel?
Acts 17:27.prayer: God, you are not far from me. Help me reach out and find you.

Deuteronomy 4:29.reflect: What would seeking God with your whole heart look like today?
Deuteronomy 4:29.prayer: God, I seek you with my whole heart. Let me find you.

Psalm 145:18.reflect: What honest prayer could you speak right now?
Psalm 145:18.prayer: God, you are near to all who call on you in truth. I call on you now.

Jeremiah 29:13.reflect: What helps you seek God when you feel far away?
Jeremiah 29:13.prayer: God, I am searching for you. Let me find you as I seek with all my heart.

Psalm 62:8.reflect: What do you need to pour out before God today?
Psalm 62:8.prayer: God, I pour out my heart to you. Be my refuge while I wait for an answer.

Psalm 77:1-2.reflect: What would you like to cry out to God today, honestly?
Psalm 77:1-2.prayer: God, I cry out to you in my trouble. Hear me, even when I cannot feel comforted.

Matthew 7:7-8.reflect: What are you still asking, seeking or knocking for?
Matthew 7:7-8.prayer: God, I keep asking and seeking. Help me trust that you hear me.

Romans 5:1.reflect: What would peace with God feel like right now?
Romans 5:1.prayer: God, thank you that I have peace with you through Jesus. Let that peace settle in me.

Psalm 29:11.reflect: Where do you need strength and peace together?
Psalm 29:11.prayer: God, give me strength and bless me with peace.

2 Thessalonians 3:16.reflect: Where do you most need peace at all times and in every way?
2 Thessalonians 3:16.prayer: Lord of peace, give me your peace at all times and in every way.

Isaiah 32:17.reflect: What would quietness and confidence look like in your day?
Isaiah 32:17.prayer: God, let your righteousness bring peace, quietness and confidence to my life.
